headline: Famed climber Nirmal Purja among 10 killed in Broad Peak avalanche
summary: An avalanche swept a 10-member expedition on Pakistan's Broad Peak; all 10 were confirmed dead, including the celebrated Nepali mountaineer Nimsdai.
script: The mountaineering world is mourning Nirmal Purja, known as Nims. He was among all ten climbers confirmed dead after an avalanche swept Broad Peak in Pakistan. Tributes are pouring out across Nepal.
imageAlt: Schoolgirls light candles at a vigil for the climber Nirmal Purja.
imageAltTwo: Students and teachers hold candles at a memorial gathering on a school lawn.
